result.rationale: Applying the DGF-decision-v8 legal rule definition to the authoritative REVIEW_FACTS_LEGAL snapshot (version 1, age 0 days), none of the eight candidate findings fire. (1) LEGAL-DPA-001 requires personal_data=true AND dpa_status in ('draft','missing'); snapshot project records "personal_data": false and legal records "dpa_status": "not_required". (2) LEGAL-LIAB-001 requires liability_cap_multiplier==0.5 AND no security carve-out; snapshot records "liability_cap_multiplier": 1 (with "security_carveout": false, but the multiplier predicate fails). (3) LEGAL-AUDIT-001 requires audit_right in ('reports_only','none'); snapshot records "audit_right": "limited". (4) LEGAL-EXIT-001 requires exit_assistance_days==0; snapshot records "exit_assistance_days": 90. (5) LEGAL-IP-001 requires ip_ownership=='ambiguous'; snapshot records "ip_ownership": "shared". (6) LEGAL-INS-001 requires insurance_valid=false; snapshot records "insurance_valid": true (cyber_insurance_m=2). (7) LEGAL-SIGN-001 requires signing_authority_valid=false; snapshot records "signing_authority_valid": true. (8) LEGAL-LOG-001 requires log_export_clause=='missing' AND business_criticality in ('High','Critical'); snapshot records "log_export_clause": "included" and project "business_criticality": "Medium", so the conjunction fails on both grounds. With an empty applicable finding set there is no finding requiring authorization: GO is not in authorization_required_for (GO_WITH_RESERVATIONS/SUSPENSION/NO_GO), so authorization_required=false. Upstream INTEGRATE-02-ARCHITECTURE-1 returned GO with no findings; the INTEGRATE-03-SECURITY-1 NO_GO findings (SEC-NET-001 etc.) are security-gate findings and do not propagate as legal-gate findings. No remediation is claimed as completed.
